title: Remote File Handoff Manifest
user: A freelancer or small team sending a private folder through a NAS, SFTP, or peer-to-peer link who needs a recipient-verifiable inventory instead of an ambiguous 'uploaded' message.
smallest_useful_product: CLI that builds a signed JSON/HTML manifest with relative paths, sizes, hashes, optional expiry/contact fields, and a recipient-side verifier; optional SFTP/NAS upload only copies the package.
success_measure: When one file is missing or altered in a 10,000-file fixture, recipient verification identifies the exact path and no unchanged file is reported as bad.
constraints: Hash filenames can reveal private information, so offer encrypted/opaque manifests; use standard cryptographic libraries; never advertise delivery guarantees when transport is external.
